summary: A hydration-only autonomous-auto child can falsely mark the newly hydrated roadmap/backlog task complete during administrative closeout when the child scope backlog_id is the hydrated task id. Hydration creates executable planning state; it does not prove implementation or acceptance completion.
evidence: In child scope 2026-04-25-autonomous-auto-slice-auto-001-f-4, the exact roadmap_scaffold.py command created T-029 for the read-only campaign audit report and no implementation work was performed. The administrative closeout then reported W2c backlog item T-029 marked complete and moved roadmap task T-029 to completed_tasks. The campaign repaired the state by restoring backlog status pending, restoring T-029 under the active v0.2.0-p3 roadmap tasks list, marking slice-auto-001-f hydrated, and preserving the next lifecycle-route as ship_task.
recommended_action: Teach closeout/autonomous-auto hydration scopes to distinguish hydration completion from delivery completion. Do not run W2c task-completion mutation when the loop decision is hydrate_task, the child scope is hydration-only, or the acceptance explicitly excludes implementation. Add a regression test that hydrates a task and verifies the resulting backlog item remains pending and the roadmap task remains active until a separate delivery child completes it.
